family.title: More reasons to love being an IKEA Family member
family.text: Make a little more room for what you love this November. Enjoy IKEA Family offers on storage and everyday home favourites, and find smart, affordable ways to keep your home organised and feeling good.

A white SOCKERBIT box with lid containing some rope and a garden hose stands on a terrace on a sunny day.

feature.title: A modern 2-room Flexi BTO, by Home design service
feature.text: We love creating homes that actually feel like homes. For this homeowner, the goal is simple: to create a cosy home she can return to at the end of each day. With thoughtful planning and smart use of space, the Home design team brought warmth, functionality and character into the home.

cards.text: From the kitchen, bedroom, living & dining areas, we have the designs & solutions for you. Book a free consultation & design your dream home together with our Design Specialists.

cards.text: When the haze and heat gets too much, our cooling range is here to save the day. Bring home the coolest blankets, pillows, mattresses and more today.

cards.text: Need an extra hand? Getting us to put it together can be a real time-saver. Now, we're making it more affordable for you to assemble your favourite products.

seoText: For more than 80 years, we work to create a better everyday life for the many people. As a furniture and home furnishing store, we do this by producing furniture and accessories that are well-designed, functional and affordable. Here you will find everything from smart home solutions to a variety of bedroom furniture, sofas, dining tables, chairs, wardrobes, textiles, cookware, decorations and more. Check out our wide range of products online and in-store.
